Scenario.task2: when ready client capture startemit capturing
Scenario.task3: when capturing client legit startemit legit_up

Bindings.set_cookies_off: bash -c "sudo sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_syncookies=0 && sudo sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_max_syn_backlog=10000"
Bindings.capture: bash -c "sudo rm -f /tmp/synflood-nocookie.pcap; sudo timeout 185 tcpdump -nn -i $expeth(server) -Z root -w /tmp/synflood-nocookie.pcap ip"
Bindings.legit: bash -c "timeout 180 bash -c 'while true; do curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 5 http://server; sleep 1; done'"
